# ---- dimensions (mm) ----
main_length = 58.7
shoulder_length = 21.3
total_length = main_length + shoulder_length

main_diameter = 38.4
shoulder_diameter = 45.3
bore_diameter = 23.1

                     (0, main_diameter / 2),
                     (main_length, main_diameter / 2),
                     (main_length, shoulder_diameter / 2),
                     (total_length, shoulder_diameter / 2),
                     (total_length, 0),

solid_body = solid_body - bore

part = solid_body
part.name = "stepped_shaft"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

overall_width = 80.0
overall_height = 76.6
thickness = 7.0
central_hole_dia = 31.5
hole_dia = 3.5
hole_depth = 1.7
hole_count = 9
hole_radius = 15.7
rib_width = 43.1
rib_height = 24.5
rib_thickness = 2.5

solid = Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(26.15, thickness)
solid = solid - Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(15.75, thickness * 2)

for i in range(hole_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / hole_count)
    px = hole_radius * math.cos(angle)
    pz = hole_radius * math.sin(angle)
    solid = solid - Pos(px, thickness/2 - hole_depth/2, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(1.75, hole_depth)

rib = Pos(0, -thickness/2 - rib_thickness/2, 0) * Box(rib_width, rib_thickness, rib_height)
solid = solid + rib

part = solid
part.name = "plate_with_rib"
export_step(part, "output.step")
